Akhilesh Yadav Launches PDA Rath Yatra from Rae Bareli

Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav has launched the 'Samajwadi PDA Yatra' from Rae Bareli, signaling the start of his campaign for the 2027 elections. The yatra, described as a show of strength, is intended to send political messages to allies and dissenting party members. It also aims to make the Congress party aware of the SP's strength before seat-sharing discussions and to energize the party organization.
